description_html:
Can you outthink the criminal mind?

Welcome to The Detective's Case Files: Volume 1, an enhanced interactive crime-solving experience engineered for true mystery buffs, logic lovers, and armchair sleuths.

Unlike ordinary puzzle books that repeat the same grid on every page, every investigation in this volume is an immersive 4-stage case file:

  • Stage 1: Forensic Evidence Sweep: 10x10 crime scene word search to recover physical evidence.
  • Stage 2: The Encrypted Dispatch: Decrypt the killer's secret cipher message.
  • Stage 3: The Alibi & Motive Matrix: Airtight logic deduction grid verified to yield 1 unique solution.
  • Stage 4: The Official Arrest Warrant: Synthesize your evidence and indict the true perpetrator!

Sharpen your pencil, assemble the evidence, and crack the case today!
